subject: Post-call: Performance/SLO follow-up & load-test coordination (FinWise)
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@finwise.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@finwise.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Performance/SLO follow-up & load-test coordination (FinWise)

Thanks for the call this morning — quick recap and next steps from our side: 

Recap / requirements we captured:
- Latency SLO: p95 <= 300ms (in production traffic mix)
- Throughput target: sustained 500 req/s for the model endpoint; peak bursts to 800 req/s
- Concurrency: ~50 concurrent streaming clients (customers will use streaming)
- Streaming: client expects chunked streaming/SSE with token-by-token streams intact

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the test window(s) you prefer next week and any blackout windows?
2) We’ll share a k6 script + a short runbook. Can you provision a test account and an IP allowlist for Redwood test runners?
3) Please confirm whether you want us to run the full load test or you’ll orchestrate customer-led runs (we can provide scripts and on-call during the window).

We’ll attach a starter k6 script and runbook (config points for concurrency, ramp, streaming emulation). Tentative test window suggestion: Thu 2027-03-25 02:00 - 06:00 UTC (low traffic) — confirm if that works.

Regards,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Attachments: redwood_k6_finwise_v1.js (k6 script stub), loadtest-runbook.pdf (runbook/stress plan)
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@finwise.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@finwise.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Performance/SLO follow-up & load-test coordination (FinWise)

Thanks Logan — great summary and appreciated the clarity. A few clarifications from our side:
- Throughput: 500 req/s sustained is what our product team expects for the first rollout; we may test up to 1k req/s in a spike test but production target is 500.
- Streaming: yes, we need chunked responses. For the load test please emulate clients opening long-lived streaming connections (avg session 30s).
- Concurrency: 50 concurrent streams should approximate expected concurrency; security is concerned about source IPs.

We can host customer-led runs. Security needs a list of IP blocks to allowlist and instructions for how the test runner authenticates (test API key or temporary token). We can provision a scoped test API key — please send the exact key name and ask for the key to be created with a 48h TTL.

Test windows: Thu 03/25 02:00-06:00 UTC is likely OK. We’ll confirm by EOD Mon. Also please send k6 or Locust variants of the script — our infra folks prefer k6.

Alex
Alex Wu
Principal PM, FinWise Payments
alex.wu@finwise.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@finwise.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@finwise.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Performance/SLO follow-up & load-test coordination (FinWise)

Hi Alex, Priya — looping in a short k6 script and a 2-page runbook that covers the main knobs (ramp, vus, duration, streaming emulation).

Notes on the script/runbook:
- k6 script (redwood_k6_finwise_v1.js) includes: auth header support for a bearer token, streaming emulation via small chunk responses and pacing, checks for p95/p50 latencies, and a hooks section to emit a conformance event if streaming frames are broken.
- Runbook covers: warmup (10m), baseline run (20m at 200 rps), full ramp to 500 rps (10m ramp), sustain at 500 rps (30m), spike test to 1k rps (5m), cooldown.
- Smoke test recommended 1h before window for connectivity & auth validation.

Attaching: redwood_k6_finwise_v1.js, loadtest-runbook.pdf

Marissa
SRE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@finwise.com>, Alex Wu <alex.wu@finwise.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Performance/SLO follow-up & load-test coordination (FinWise)

Thanks Marissa — script looks good. A couple security/ops items we need from you to proceed: 

1) IP allowlist: please add the Redwood loadtest runner ranges below (these are our egress blocks for hosted test runners).
- 52.23.45.0/24
- 34.201.120.0/22
- 18.207.10.0/24

2) Test account: please create a scoped API key named "finwise-loadtest-03-25" with 48h TTL and post the key to the secure channel (do not email the key). If you prefer, we can use OAuth temporary tokens — we just need a mechanism to pass the token to the k6 runner.

3) Confirmation of test window: Thu 2027-03-25 02:00 - 06:00 UTC (Redwood to run smoke at 01:00 UTC if you can allow a quick smoke).

4) Success criteria (to agree before run):
- p95 <= 300ms for the streaming endpoint under sustained 500 rps
- No dropped streaming frames (we’ll surface per-connection error rates)
- Error rate <= 1% for 500 rps sustained run

If this all looks good I’ll schedule an on-call from Redwood SRE for the window and share the runbook link in the incident channel.

Cheers,
Logan
From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@finwise.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Alex Wu <alex.wu@finwise.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Performance/SLO follow-up & load-test coordination (FinWise)

Logan / team — all good from Security & Prod infra side: 
- We added the 3 IP blocks to the allowlist for the test window.
- Security will provision the scoped API key "finwise-loadtest-03-25" (48h TTL) and share it via our secure vault by 2027-03-24 18:00 UTC.
- We can support the smoke test at 2027-03-25 01:00 UTC. Please keep the smoke limited to auth/connectivity checks and low RPS (10-20 rps).
- One constraint: our streaming gateway has a hard 600 concurrent connection cap per region — please ensure your test runner caps concurrent streaming clients to 600 across all runners. For our expected traffic (50 concurrent) this is fine, but we saw issues in an earlier spike test.

Confirming full-run window: Thu 2027-03-25 02:00 - 06:00 UTC. We’ll have on-call infra available.

Thanks — Priya
